title: An orthonormal partner of a unit vector in a 2-plane, with the coordinate expansion
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P with dim Q = 2, and let z ∈ Q with ‖z‖ = 1. Then there is e ∈ Q with ‖e‖ = 1 and ⟨z, e⟩ = 0 such that every w ∈ Q satisfies w = ⟨w, z⟩ z + ⟨w, e⟩ e.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → z ∈ Q → ‖z‖ = 1 → ∃ e : Euclid P, e ∈ Q ∧ ‖e‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ z e = 0 ∧ ∀ w ∈ Q, w = inner ℝ w z • z + inner ℝ w e • e
